audit verifies M2659 includes M2657/M2658 and keeps protected mitigation failure blocking
audit registers a bounded follow-up without ranking validation training promotion or performance claims
failure_criteria: M2660 executes reset step rollout replay validation training source build adapter probe or external simulation
M2660 ranks controller families selects a winner promotes a checkpoint or claims driver performance
M2660 treats protected mitigation rows as ordinary success denominators
decision_rule: Pass only if M2660 audits M2659 index artifacts, keeps target/protected split and protected failure blocking, and registers a bounded follow-up without ranking validation training promotion performance paper high-fidelity or self-ID claims.
